inclusion: Hosted settings first recorded after the six manuscript hosted settings, with three complete passes under the manuscript protocol: the frozen dataset, 2 s recording interval, 32 workers and the same client. Wity-1 has one pass per reasoning mode at 16 workers and is excluded; self-hosted cohorts on other hosts are outside this section.
fast_rule: A native decision interface whose mean per-pass median latency is below the recording interval acts as the fast component.
composition: Every fast component is paired with the correctors and arbitration rules of trajectory_policy.json, matching pass indices on common nominal releases.
selection: Adopted after all seven settings were recorded; settings, roles, correctors and rules follow from the rules above, not from evaluated scores.
